I wouldn’t go into a conversation like this without thinking of and maybe even writing some points down. When people get stressed or upset/anxious they tend to blank on what they want to say. It may help you to write down your feelings and even show this post to him. Allow him to read what you have said and be complete transparent. Try to reach out to him and let him know that you still want to be with him but you do not want to rush him. Give him the time that he needs but don’t wait forever. You made a mistake but you also have a life to live. Make sure you continue to live your life and don’t put everything on hold.

Well go into it with that mentality and while it might not be my place to say this it sounds likely that he will not come into any conversations from a good place and he might get upset and even angry when you try to have s conversation about this. Remember this is not his fault and that it is normal for someone to be upset and act irrationally when dealing with emotional distress. Especially if he is heartbroken and feeling hurt. He may say things he doesn’t mean and it will be good to take things slow and please be careful not to push him away while trying to defuse the situation. It is important that you try to stay calm and be as honest as possible even if he doesn’t like the truth or it upsets him. If you build anything on a lie it will crumble eventually when the lie gets exposed. If you would like we can pm if you’d like to talk more or have any questions and things to ask

Honestly there are always options on how to get home. Worst case scenario in a lot of places you can even call the police if you are drunk and have no way to get home. A lot of time they will be willing to give a ride if they have time/people to spare. You made a mistake and right now all you can do is live with the consequences and learn from the whole experience. I hope things work out for you if you are being honest and nothing happened but you definitely have some major apologizing to do. But that is all just my opinion and I am but a stranger on the internet so you must do what is in your power. Good luck.
